svg.text: Generated by tools/previews/record_figures.py from requirements/SYS-*.yaml and safety/hazards/HAZ-*.yaml. Drafted at independence level I0; nothing shown here is reviewed, verified or accepted.

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · BMS = battery management system · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 =
review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SUS-A1 = dockable
observation UAV · SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter · SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance

control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power

generation, storage, distribution and thermal control · SUS-M1-PWR-BAT = battery pack, BMS and contactors (alternative B) · SUS-M1-PWR-GEN = engine-generator and governor (alternative B) · SUS-M1-SAF =

independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability sensing · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) ·
